headline: Entergy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Sales Improve Year Over Year
summary: ETR beats Q2 earnings estimates as industrial demand boosts retail sales, even as higher costs and interest expense weigh on quarterly results.

headline: CMS Energy plans to sell renewable assets to focus on regulated utilities
summary: The Jackson, Michigan-based company said the move would simplify its corporate structure, net about $500 million and set it up to generate nearly all of its earnings from its regulated utilities after 2027.

headline: Mizuho Maintains Neutral on CMS Energy, Lowers Price Target to $77
summary: Mizuho  analyst Anthony Crowdell   maintains CMS Energy (NYSE:CMS) with a Neutral and lowers the price target from $78 to $77.
